title: Pull from Below
description: Deal 5 damage for each [gold]Ethereal[/gold] card played this combat.
upgraded_description: Deal 7 damage for each [gold]Ethereal[/gold] card played this combat.
notes: This card's damage is multiplied by the total number of Ethereal cards played by the player during this combat. During combat, it displays how many times the attack will hit based on the Ethereal cards played so far.
